name: Survivor Identity
description: What happened to them IS them, and they won't let you forget it
behavioral_signature: Defines themselves entirely by the trauma they endured
under_stress: Retreats into victimhood as a shield and weapon
at_rest: Tells their story to anyone who will listen
will_always: reference their survival as their core credential
will_never: let anyone minimize what they went through
unless: they finally decide to become more than what happened to them
